children: M&T refreshed its Medium-Term Note Program and registered Series C senior and Series D subordinated notes under Form S-3.
Refreshed Medium-Term Note Program to issue Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series C, under the Senior Indenture.
Will issue Subordinated Medium-Term Notes, Series D, under the Subordinated Indenture, establishing subordinated debt availability.
Both series are authorized by officers’ certificates dated September 22, 2026, under applicable indenture sections.
Notes registered under the Securities Act via Form S-3, File No. 333-299064, filed September 22, 2026.
